blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Accurate and early classification of brain tumours from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for treatment planning, yet many published deep learning studies are trained and tested on small, single-source datasets, reporting accuracies that may not hold outside these datasets. This study compares six deep learning architectures for four-class classification (healthy, meningioma, glioma and pituitary tumour): a baseline convolutional neural network (CNN), an attention-based CNN, ShuffleNet, and EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50 and Xception augmented with the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM). The models were trained on a corpus assembled from four publicly available MRI datasets. Because these datasets carry no patient identifiers, a leakage-aware pipeline was developed that removes exact duplicates using MD5 hashing (550 images) and near-duplicates using perceptual hashing (8,024 images), and assigns visually similar images to the same fold during 5-fold group cross-validation. A leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) test on a fully held-out dataset was used to measure cross-dataset generalisation. Under a conventional random split, ShuffleNet achieved 97.1% accuracy with 1.2M parameters. Under leakage-aware group K-fold cross-validation, ShuffleNetV2 (98.41%) and EfficientNet-B0 (98.23%) were statistically indistinguishable (paired t-test, p = 0.19), and both significantly outperformed the custom CNNs. On the held-out dataset, accuracy dropped for every model: EfficientNet-B0 generalised best (78.4%), while ShuffleNetV2 fell to 66.2%. Glioma-meningioma confusion was the dominant error mode, and Grad-CAM maps showed that predictions were driven by tumour regions. These results indicate that in-distribution accuracy alone overstates real-world performance and that leakage-aware and cross-dataset evaluation should be reported alongside it.
blocks.zh: 对磁共振成像(MRI)产生的脑肿瘤进行准确和早期的分类对于治疗规划至关重要,然而许多已出版的深度学习研究却在小型的单源数据集上得到培训和测试,报告强度可能不在这些数据集之外. 本研究比较了四类分类(健康、脑膜瘤、胶囊瘤和垂体肿瘤)的六种深层学习结构:基线神经网络(CNN)、基于注意力的有线电视新闻网、ShuffleNet和高效Net-B0、ResNet-50和Xception,并配有 " 进化分块注意力模块 " (CBAM)。 这些模型接受了关于从四个公开的核磁共振数据集组装的核磁共振仪的培训。 因为这些数据集没有携带病人识别器,因此开发出一条有渗漏意识的管道来去除使用MD5 hashing(550个图像)的精确重复和使用能感知到的hashing(8,024个图像)的近似复制,并在5倍分组交叉验证时将视觉相近的图像分配到同一折叠上. 在一个完全被搁置的数据集上进行了留一数据集(LODO)测试,以测量跨数据集的通论. 在常规的随机分拆下,ShuffleNet以1.2M参数实现了97.1%的精度. 在有渗漏意识的K倍交叉验证组下,ShuffleNetV2(98.41%)和高效Net-B0(98.23%)在统计学上是无法区分的(paired t-t-test,p=0.19),两者的性能都大大超过自定义的CNN. 在被搁置的数据集上,每个模型的精度下降: 高效Net-B0 通用最佳(78.4%),而ShuffleNetV2则下降到66.2%. Glioma-meningioma混淆是最主要的出错模式,Grad-CAM地图显示预测由肿瘤区域所驱动. 这些结果表明,仅分配中的准确性就过分夸大了现实世界的绩效,同时应报告渗漏意识和跨数据集评价。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Brain tumors are among the most life-threatening neurological disorders because of their aggressive growth and the complexity of their presentation. Early and accurate diagnosis is important for timely treatment and improves patient survival rates. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is considered the gold standard for the non-invasive detection and classification of brain tumors, as it provides detailed visualization of tumor morphology in a short acquisition time.
blocks.zh: 脑瘤是危害生命的神经系统疾病之一,因为它们具有侵略性生长和表现的复杂性. 及早准确诊断对及时治疗和提高患者存活率十分重要. 磁共振成像(MRI)被认为是脑瘤非侵入性检测和分类的金本位,因为它在短时间内提供了肿瘤形态的详细可视化.

blocks.en: However, manual interpretation of MRI scans is time-consuming and prone to error, particularly for early-stage lesions and for tumor types that differ only subtly, such as meningiomas and gliomas. This has highlighted the need for automated tools that support radiologists in decision-making. The advent of machine learning and deep learning, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), has transformed medical image analysis and enabled high accuracy in brain tumor identification and classification from imaging data.
blocks.zh: 然而,对核磁共振扫描的人工解释很费时,容易出错,特别是对于早期的损伤和只有微小差异的肿瘤类型,如脑膜炎和胶瘤。 这突出表明需要自动化工具,支持放射学家的决策。 机器学习和深层学习的出现,特别是进化神经网络(CNNs)的出现,改变了医学图像分析,使得脑瘤识别和从成像数据中分类的精度很高.

blocks.en: 1.1 CNN-Based Approaches for Brain Tumor Classification
blocks.zh: 1.1 基于CNN的脑肿瘤分类方法

blocks.en: Traditional CNN architectures: Modern brain tumor classification (BTC) has been built largely on CNN-based models with various architectural modifications ( Sultan et al., 2019 ; Kibriya et al., 2022b ; Garg et al., 2023 ; Singh et al., 2023 ) , which have shown high success rates in tumor detection and classification. Sultan et al. (2019) were among the first to apply CNNs to BTC, working with two datasets: in the first, tumors were classified into three primary types (meningioma, glioma and pituitary tumor), and in the second, into three glioma grades. Their study achieved overall accuracies of 96.13% and 98.7% on the first and second datasets, respectively.
blocks.zh: 传统的CNN架构: 现代脑瘤分类(BTC)基本建立在基于CNN的模型上,并经过各种建筑改造(Sultan等人,2019年;Kibriya等人,2022b;Garg等人,2023年;Singh等人,2023年),这些模型在肿瘤检测和分类方面表现出很高的成功率. Sultan等人(2019年)是最早将CNN应用于BTC的国家之一,他们与两个数据集合作:第一个是肿瘤分为三种主要类型(meningioma,glioma和垂体瘤),第二个是三等胶囊级. 他们的研究在第一和第二套数据上分别取得了96.13%和98.7%。

blocks.en: Building on this foundation, Kibriya et al. (2022a) proposed a 13-layer CNN designed specifically for this application and achieved 97.2% accuracy, suggesting that deeper architectures capture complex tumor features more effectively. Garg et al. (2023) developed a 14-layer 2D deep CNN that achieved a test accuracy of 98.66%, showing continued improvement through architectural refinement.
blocks.zh: 在这个基础上,Kibriya等人(2022a)提出了专门为这一应用设计的13层CNN,并实现了97.2%的精度,这表明更深层的建筑能更有效地捕捉复杂的肿瘤特征. Garg等人(2023年)开发了14层2D深的CNN,实现了98.66%的测试精度,通过建筑的完善显示出持续改善.

blocks.en: Badža and Barjaktarović (2020) worked with T1-weighted contrast-enhanced MRI images, as did several later studies ( Alhassan and Zainon, 2021 ; Tummala et al., 2022 ; Mzoughi et al., 2025 ) . They performed record-wise and subject-wise 10-fold cross-validation on both the original and augmented image databases, and found that the record-wise approach gave a higher accuracy (96.56%) than the subject-wise approach.
blocks.zh: Badža和Barjaktarović(2020年)与后来的一些研究(Alhassan和Zainon,2021年;Tummala等人,2022年;Mzoughi等人,2025年)一样,与T1加权对比增强的核磁共振图像合作。 在原始的和扩充的图像数据库中,他们都以记录方式和主题方式进行了10倍的交叉验证,发现记录方式的准确度(96.56%)高于主题方式。

blocks.en: Multi-task CNN models: Extending beyond single-task classification, Singh et al. (2023) used three distinct CNN models for separate categorization tasks. The first model classified brain tumors with an accuracy of 99.74%. The second achieved 96.27% accuracy in differentiating normal brain tissue from glioma, meningioma, pituitary and metastatic tumors. The third distinguished tumor grades II, III and IV with an accuracy of 99.18%, highlighting the versatility of CNNs across classification scenarios. Gull et al. (2023) performed a similar study on a combination of three datasets (Kaggle, Figshare and REMBRANDT). Their first model separated tumor from non-tumor images with 99.40% accuracy, the second performed three-class classification of meningioma, glioma and pituitary tumors with 97.78% accuracy, and the third classified four tumor grades (I–IV) with 98.91% accuracy. Alhassan and Zainon (2021) proposed a hard-swish-based ReLU activation function within a CNN, achieving 98.6% accuracy in BTC.
blocks.zh: 多任务CNN模型:超越单任务分类,Singh等人(2023年)将三个不同的CNN模型用于单独的分类任务. 第一种模型将脑瘤分类,精度达到99.74%. 第二项在区分正常脑组织与胶原瘤、脑膜瘤、垂体瘤和元静脉瘤方面实现了96.27%的准确性。 第三个突出的肿瘤等级为二,三,四级,精度达到99.18%,凸显了CNN跨分类情景的多功能性. 古尔等人. (2023年)对三个数据集(Kaggle,Figshare和REMBRANDT)的组合进行了类似的研究. 他们的第一个模型以99.40%的精度将肿瘤从非肿瘤图像中分离出来,第二个模型以97.78%的精度对脑膜瘤,胶球瘤和垂体瘤进行了三等分类,第三个模型以98.91%的精度对四个肿瘤等级(I–IV)进行了分类. Alhassan和Zainon(2021年)在CNN内提出了硬的ReLU激活功能,在BTC中实现了98.6%的精度.

blocks.en: 1.2 Advanced Deep Learning Architectures
blocks.zh: 1.2 高级深层学习结构

blocks.en: Densely connected networks: Prakash et al. (2023) introduced a densely connected convolutional network (DenseNet) for BTC, evaluated on a public dataset of 3,064 MR images covering meningioma, glioma and pituitary tumors ( Kibriya et al., 2022b ) . DenseNet outperformed VGG16, SVM and AlexNet, achieving an accuracy of 97.39%.
blocks.zh: 紧密连接的网络 : Prakash等人(2023年)为BTC引入了一个连接紧密的革命网络(DenseNet),在3,064MR图像公共数据集上进行了评价,这些图像涵盖脑膜瘤、胶质瘤和垂体瘤(Kibriya等人,2022年b)。 DenseNet的性能超过了VGG16,SVM和AlexNet,实现了97.39%的精度.

blocks.en: Hierarchical deep learning approaches: Shajin et al. (2023) proposed a framework for the BraTS dataset ( Khan et al., 2023 ) that used a hierarchical deep learning neural network (HieDNN) classifier to handle complex medical imaging data and perform BTC.
blocks.zh: 分级深入学习的方法: Shajin等人(2023年)为BratS数据集(Khan等人,2023年)提出了一个框架,使用分级的深层学习神经网络(HieDNN)分类器来处理复杂的医学成像数据并进行BTC.

blocks.en: 1.3 Transfer Learning and Pre-trained Models
blocks.zh: 1.3 转移学习和预培训模式

blocks.en: EfficientNet-based transfer learning: Transfer learning has shown considerable success in brain tumor classification. Zulfiqar et al. (2023) fine-tuned pre-trained EfficientNets and achieved an overall test accuracy, precision, recall and F1-score of 98.86%, 98.65%, 98.77% and 98.71%, respectively, on the Figshare brain tumor dataset, a dataset also used by Mahum et al. (2023) , Babu Vimala et al. (2023) and Gull et al. (2023) . Babu Vimala et al. (2023) subsequently fine-tuned five EfficientNet variants (B0–B4) and found that EfficientNetB2 gave the best results, with an accuracy of 99.06%, precision of 98.73%, recall of 99.13% and F1-score of 98.79%. Owida et al. (2024) derived a new architecture from EfficientNetB3 that reached 100% accuracy on a dataset of 7,023 MRI scans.
blocks.zh: 高效 净转移学习: 转移学习在脑瘤分类方面显示出相当大的成功. Zulfiqar等人(2023年)在Figshare脑瘤数据集上微调了预训的高效网络,并实现了总的测试精度,精度,召回率和F1-分数分别为98.86%,98.65%,98.77%和98.71%,这个数据集也被Mahum等人(2023年),Babu Vimala等人(2023年)和Gull等人(2023年)使用. Babu Vimala等人(2023年)随后对5种高效网络变体(B0–B4)进行了微调,发现高效网络B2给出了最佳效果,精度为99.06%,精度为98.73%,召回率为99.13%,F1-分数为98.79%. Owida等人(2024年)从高效NetB3中衍生出一个新的架构,在一个7 023个核磁共振扫描的数据集中达到了100%的精度.

blocks.en: Enhanced deep transfer learning methods: Masood et al. (2022) combined attention with an established architecture, using ResNet34 enhanced with attention blocks as the base network for brain tumor identification and classification. Their approach achieved 98.98% accuracy, demonstrating the value of attention in focusing on relevant image regions. Asif et al. (2023) conducted two experiments with five models: Xception, DenseNet201, DenseNet121, ResNet152V2 and InceptionResNetV2. The first experiment classified three classes (meningioma, glioma and pituitary), and the second added a fourth class for healthy subjects. The Xception-based model achieved the highest accuracy in both: 99.67% on the three-class task and 95.87% on the four-class task. Malkauthekar et al. (2025) presented a Probabilistic Bi-Level Teaching–Learning-Based Optimization (P-BTLBO) algorithm for hybrid feature extraction and multi-class brain tumor classification using ResNet-50 and GLCM features. Kanna and Salau (2025) proposed a penguin-search-optimized quantum-enhanced support vector machine (PSO-QESVM) that used ResNet and VGG16 to extract features from the pre-processed data, achieving an accuracy of 98.90%, recall of 98.9%, F1-score of 98.5% and precision of 98.7%.
blocks.zh: 加强深度转移学习方法: Masood等人(2022年)将注意力与既定的架构结合起来,利用ResNet34增强后的关注块作为脑瘤识别和分类的基础网络. 他们的方法达到了98.98%的准确度,显示了关注相关图像区域的价值。 Asif等人(2023年)用五个模型进行了两个实验:Xception,DenseNet201,DenseNet121,ResNet152V2和InceptionResNetV2. 第一次实验分为三个类(meningioma,glioma和垂体),第二次实验增加了健康学科的第四类. 基于Xception的模型都实现了最高的精度:99.67%在三等任务上,95.87%在四等任务上. Malkauthekar等人(2025年)利用ResNet-50和GLCM的特性,提出了用于混合特征提取和多级脑瘤分类的概率双层教学-学习优化(P-BTLBO)算法。 Kanna和Salau(2025年)提出企鹅搜索优化量子增强支持矢量机(PSO-QESVM),使用ResNet和VGG16从预处理数据中提取特性,实现98.90%的精度,召回98.9%,F1-分数98.5%,精度98.7%.

blocks.en: 1.4 Hybrid Approaches and Feature Fusion
blocks.zh: 1.4 混合办法和特征融合

blocks.en:
Segmentation–classification integration: Mahum et al. (2023) combined segmentation and feature fusion for brain tumor detection. Working with the Figshare and Harvard datasets ( Mostafa et al., 2023 ; Tummala et al., 2022 ) , they used a bidirectional LSTM network to classify tumors into pituitary, glioma and meningioma.
Because segmentation is time-consuming, Mostafa et al. (2023) instead pre-processed the images with a Gaussian filter (GF) and SynthStrip to improve localization, achieving 99.8% accuracy, 99.3% recall, 99.4% precision, a 99.5% F1-score and an AUC of 0.989. Khan et al. (2023) presented a hybrid framework that used a U-Net for segmentation and an SVM to separate normal from tumor-affected images, achieving an overall accuracy of 98.95%, specificity of 98.13% and sensitivity of 97.46%. Özyurt et al. (2020) used fuzzy C-means with super-resolution (SR-FCM) to detect tumors in low-resolution MRI scans, extracted features with SqueezeNet, and classified them with an extreme learning machine (ELM), achieving an overall accuracy of 98.33%.
blocks.zh:
分区-分类整合: Mahum等人(2023年)结合分化和特征聚变进行脑瘤检测. 与Figshare和哈佛数据集(Mostafa等人,2023年;Tummala等人,2022年)合作,他们使用双向LSTM网络将肿瘤分类为垂体,胶原和meningioma.
由于分化耗时,Mostafa等人(2023年)转而用高斯滤波器(GF)和合成器(SynthStrip)对图像进行预处理,以提高本地化,实现99.8%的精度,99.3%的回溯,99.4%的精度,99.5%的F1-分数和0.989的AUC. 汗等编. (2023年)介绍了一种混合框架,使用U-Net进行分化,使用SVM将正常图像与肿瘤影响图像分离,总体精度达到98.95%,特异性达到98.13%,灵敏度达到97.46%. Özyurt等人(2020年)使用具有超分辨率(SR-FCM)的绒毛C-means在低分辨率核磁共振扫描中检测肿瘤,提取SqueezeNet的特征,并将其分类为极端学习机(ELM),总体精度达到98.33%.

blocks.en: Ensemble methods and deep feature integration: Kang et al. (2021) used 13 pre-trained deep CNNs as feature extractors together with nine machine learning (ML) classifiers. The three best-performing deep features were concatenated into an ensemble feature set that was then fed back into the ML classifiers. Sandhiya and Raja (2023) performed a similar study using deep CNN (DCNN) features and ML classifiers, comparing ten pre-trained DCNN feature extractors with five ML classifiers. An SVM with an RBF kernel on DenseNet features gave the best performance. Alturki et al. (2023) extracted features with a deep CNN and classified them with a voting classifier that combined logistic regression and stochastic gradient descent, achieving an accuracy of 99.9%.
blocks.zh: 集成方法和深度特征整合: Kang等人(2021年)将13台经过预训的深层CNN作为特征提取器,同时使用9台机器学习(ML)分类器. 三个表现最出色的深层特征被组合成一个综艺特征集,然后被反馈回ML分类器. Sandhiya和Raja(2023年)利用深层CNN(DCNN)特性和ML分类器进行了类似的研究,将10个经过预训的DCNN特性提取器和5个ML分类器进行比较. 一个在DenseNet功能上具有RBF内核的SVM获得了最好的性能. Alturki等人(2023年)提取了带有深层CNN的特征,并将其分类为表决分级器,该分级器结合了物流回归和扭曲梯度下降,实现了99.9%的精度.

blocks.en: Vision transformer ensembles: Tummala et al. (2022) used an ensemble of Vision Transformer (ViT) models for three-class classification. The best individual model (L/32) achieved 98.2% accuracy, whereas the ensemble of all four ViT models achieved 98.7%. Tanone et al. (2025) proposed ViT-CB, which used a ViT for feature extraction, PCA for dimensionality reduction and CatBoost for classification, with SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) used to interpret the results. The method achieved accuracies of 99.32% and 90.00% on its two evaluation datasets. Chandraprabha et al. (2025) presented an end-to-end ViT–CNN architecture that achieved 99.64% accuracy on a dataset of 4,855 images spanning several tumor classes. Mzoughi et al. (2025) trained a deep ViT for multi-class classification of common primary tumors (gliomas, meningiomas and pituitary tumors) and explained its predictions with Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM), Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) and SHAP. The CNN and ViT achieved test accuracies of 83.37% and 91.61%, respectively.
blocks.zh: 视变器组合: Tummala等人(2022年)在三类分类中使用了视觉变形器(ViT)模型的组合. 最佳单项模型(L/32)的精度达到98.2%,而所有四个ViT模型的综艺则达到98.7%。 塔诺内等人. (2025年)提出了VIT-CB,它使用VIT进行特征提取,PCA进行维度降低,CatBoost进行分类,Shapley Additive ex Planations(SHAP)用于解释结果. 该方法在两个评价数据集上达到99.32%和90.0%的速率。 Chandraprabha 等人(2025年)介绍了一个端到端的ViT-CNN架构,在覆盖多个肿瘤类别的4,855张图像数据集上实现了99.64%的精度. Mzoughi等人(2025年)为常见初级肿瘤(胶瘤、脑膜瘤和垂体瘤)的多级分类培训了深维T,并用渐变加权类活性图谱(Grad-CAM),局部可解释模型-不可知解释(LIME)和SHAP来解释其预测. CNN和VIT分别实现了83.37%和91.61%的测试速率.

blocks.en: Deep CNN feature fusion: Kibriya et al. (2022b) presented a multiclass BTC method based on deep feature fusion, extending their previous work. Features from AlexNet, GoogLeNet and ResNet18 were fused into a single feature vector and classified with a support vector machine (SVM) and K-nearest neighbors (KNN), achieving an accuracy of 99.7%. Haq et al. (2023) proposed DCNNBT, a deep CNN for brain tumor detection and classification that outperformed six established pre-trained models (SE-ResNet-101, SE-ResNet-152, SENet-154, ResNet152V2, EfficientNetB0 and EfficientNetB5) with an accuracy of 99.18%. Albalawi et al. (2024) combined CNNs with a federated learning framework for BTC, using a modified VGG16 and highlighting the value of federated and transfer learning in medical imaging. This approach achieved an accuracy of 98%.
blocks.zh: 深色CNN特征聚变:Kibriya等人(2022b)提出了基于深色特征聚变的多级BTC方法,扩展了他们之前的工作. 来自AlexNet,GoogleNet和ResNet18的特性被熔化成单一特性矢量,并被分类为辅助矢量机(SVM)和K-近邻(KNN),达到99.7%的精度. Haq等人(2023年)提出了DCNNBT,这是用于脑瘤检测和分类的深层CNN,其性能超过了6个已确立的预先训练的模型(SE-ResNet-101,SE-ResNet-152,SENet-154,ResNet152V2,高效NetB0和高效NetB5),精度达到99.18%. Albalawi等人(2024年)将CNN与BTC的联邦学习框架相结合,使用经过修改的VGG16并突出医学成像中联邦学习和转移学习的价值. 这种方法的准确度达到98%。

blocks.en: 1.5 Research Gaps
blocks.zh: 1.5 研究差距

blocks.en: The literature review identified several critical gaps. First, most studies used relatively small, single-source datasets. This limits diversity in patient population and imaging conditions and is compounded by the lack of standardized evaluation protocols, highlighting the need for larger datasets that combine multiple sources.
blocks.zh: 文献审查查明了若干重大差距。 首先,大多数研究都使用相对较小的单源数据集. 这限制了患者人口和成像条件的多样性,又因缺乏标准化的评价协议而变得更加复杂,凸显出需要结合多种来源的更大的数据集.

blocks.en: Second, there is a gap between the high accuracies reported in research settings and the performance expected in clinical practice, and many complex ensemble and hybrid approaches may be impractical for real-time deployment. Little attention has been paid to optimizing models for clinical environments with computational constraints and diverse patient populations.
blocks.zh: 第二,在研究环境报告的高强度与临床实践的预期性能之间存在差距,许多复杂的综艺和混合方法对于实时部署可能不切实际。 很少注意优化临床环境的模型,这些模型具有计算限制和不同的病人群体。

blocks.en: Third, evaluation methodologies and preprocessing approaches are inconsistent across studies, and few comparisons use identical datasets and evaluation criteria, which makes results difficult to compare. Finally, although some recent works incorporate explainable AI (XAI) techniques, many earlier approaches lacked interpretability, which limits clinical validation and motivates better integration of explainability methods.
blocks.zh: 第三,评价方法和预处理方法在不同的研究中不一致,很少采用相同的数据集和评价标准进行比较,结果难以比较。 最后,虽然最近的一些著作纳入了解释性AI(AI)技术,但早期的许多方法缺乏解释性,限制了临床验证,促使解释性方法更好地融合.

blocks.en: 1.6 Objectives
blocks.zh: 1.6 目标

blocks.en: The primary objective of this research is to develop a comprehensive and clinically applicable deep learning framework for automated brain tumor classification that addresses these limitations. Specifically, this study aims to: • integrate four publicly available datasets into a large, diverse brain tumor dataset with standardized preprocessing; • systematically evaluate and compare deep learning and transfer learning architectures under identical evaluation protocols; • identify models that balance classification accuracy with computational efficiency for real-time clinical deployment; • establish leakage-aware evaluation protocols that measure generalization across imaging sources; and • achieve strong multi-class classification performance while addressing the methodological inconsistencies identified in the literature.
blocks.zh: 这项研究的主要目标是为自动化脑瘤分类制定一个在临床上适用的综合深层学习框架,以解决这些局限性。 具体地说,这项研究的目的是:将四个公开可用的数据集整合到一个大型、多样化的脑瘤数据集中,进行标准化的预处理;根据相同的评价协议,系统地评价和比较深层学习和转移学习架构;确定在分类准确性与计算效率之间保持平衡的模型,用于实时临床部署;建立了解渗漏的评价协议,以衡量跨成像源的通用性;以及——在解决文献中发现的方法不一致的同时,实现强有力的多类分类性能.

blocks.en: 2 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 2 实验设置

blocks.en: 2.1 Hardware and Software Environment
blocks.zh: 2.1 硬件和软件环境

blocks.en: 2.1.1 Computing Infrastructure
blocks.zh: 2.1.1 电子计算基础设施

blocks.en: Initial experiments were conducted on a laptop with an NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 GPU, an 11th-generation Intel Core i5-11400H processor (2.70 GHz), 16 GB of RAM and 477 GB of storage, running a 64-bit operating system. Because of these hardware limitations, the combined dataset could not be loaded into memory at once. Batch sizes were therefore limited to 8–16 images, data generators were used to load images on demand, preprocessing was performed in smaller chunks, and model checkpoints were saved frequently to prevent loss of progress during long training sessions. These measures increased the overall training time.
blocks.zh: 在一台笔记本电脑上进行了初步的实验,配备了一台NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 GPU,一台第11代Intel Core i5-11400H处理器(2.70 GHz),16GB的RAM和477GB的存储,运行了一个64位的操作系统. 由于这些硬件限制,综合数据集无法同时装入内存. 因此,批量的尺寸限于8至16幅图像,数据生成器用于按需装入图像,在较小的块内进行预处理,并经常节省示范检查站,以防止在长时间的培训课程中丧失进度。 这些措施增加了总的培训时间。

blocks.en: 2.1.2 Software Stack
blocks.zh: 2.1.2 软件堆栈

blocks.en: To overcome the memory limitations of the local setup, model development and training were migrated to the Kaggle platform, which provides NVIDIA Tesla P100 and T4 GPUs with substantially more memory than the local GTX 1650. The software stack comprised TensorFlow 2.8.2 with Keras 2.8.0 and PyTorch for model implementation, supported by NumPy 1.21.6 for array operations, Pandas 1.3.5 for data management, OpenCV 4.6.0 for image processing and Scikit-learn 1.0.2 for evaluation metrics. Visualization and analysis were performed with Matplotlib 3.5.3 and Seaborn 0.11.2.
blocks.zh: 为了克服本地设置的内存限制,模型开发和培训被迁移到Kaggle平台,该平台为NVIDIA Tesla P100和T4 GPU提供了比本地GTX 1650更多的内存. 软件堆栈由TensorFlow 2.8.2和Keras 2.8.0和PyTorch组成,用于模型执行,由用于阵列操作的NumPy 1.21.6支持,用于数据管理的Pandas 1.3.5支持,用于图像处理的OpenCV 4.6.0支持,用于评价测量的Scikit-learn 1.0.2支持. 与Matplotlib 3.5.3和Seaborn 0.11.2进行了可视化和分析。

blocks.en: 2.2 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 2.2 评价议定书

blocks.en: 2.2.1 Cluster-Aware Group K-Fold Cross-Validation
blocks.zh: 2.2.1 集群-软件组

blocks.en: The source datasets do not provide patient identifiers, so images from the same patient, or duplicated images, could appear in both training and test sets and inflate the reported performance through data leakage. To obtain a robust, leakage-free estimate of model performance, a 5-fold Group K-Fold cross-validation strategy was employed. Unlike standard K-Fold validation, Group K-Fold ensures that samples belonging to the same group are never split across training and validation folds.
blocks.zh: 源数据集不提供患者识别器,因此同一患者的图像,或复制的图像,既可以在培训和测试集中出现,又可以通过数据泄漏来提升报告的表现. 为了获得对模型性能的可靠和无渗漏估计,采用了5倍的Group K-Fold交叉验证策略. 与标准的K-Fold验证不同,Group K-Fold确保属于同一组的样本从不被分割到培训和验证折叠之间.

blocks.en: Groups were defined by perceptual hash (pHash) clustering of the deduplicated images (Section 3.3.4 ), so that visually similar MRI slices were assigned to the same cluster. These cluster identifiers were used as grouping constraints, and all images in a given cluster were therefore assigned to a single fold, preventing leakage from highly correlated samples.
blocks.zh: 组合是通过对破损图像(第3.3.4节)的感知散列(pHash)集群来定义的,因此视觉上相似的磁共振切片被分配到同一个集群. 这些集群标识符被用作集群约束,因此,特定集群中的所有图像都被分配到单一的折叠上,防止高度关联的样本渗漏.

In each round, models were trained on four folds and evaluated on the remaining fold. Performance metrics were averaged across the five folds.

blocks.en: 2.2.2 Leave-One-Dataset-Out (LODO) Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.2.2 离休 -- -- 一个数据集 -- -- 评价

blocks.en: To assess cross-dataset generalization, a Leave-One-Dataset-Out (LODO) protocol was adopted, in which all images from one source dataset were held out entirely for testing while the remaining datasets were used for training. The Lakshan dataset (Dataset 3) was used as the held-out source because it is the only one that contains all four classes; the other sources each lack at least one class and therefore cannot serve as a four-class test set.

blocks.en: 3 Datasets and Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 3 数据集和预处理

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集建设

blocks.en: This study used four publicly available brain tumor MRI datasets to build a large and diverse training corpus (Fig. 1 ), addressing the limitation of single-source datasets identified in the literature review. Merging these datasets increased both the quantity and the diversity of the data, which is expected to improve the robustness of models trained on it.

blocks.en: 3.2 Standard Training Preprocessing Pipeline (TensorFlow)
blocks.zh: 3.2 标准培训预处理管道(TensorFlow)

blocks.en: This pipeline was used for model training under standard train–validation–test splits, reflecting common practice in brain tumor classification studies. It was implemented in TensorFlow–Keras to take advantage of efficient data loading and on-the-fly augmentation through the tf.data API. Parallel processing and prefetching with tf.data.AUTOTUNE minimized I/O bottlenecks, and a fixed random seed (42) was used for shuffling to ensure reproducibility.
blocks.zh: 这种管道用于标准列车-验证-测试分裂的模型培训,反映了脑瘤分类研究中的常见做法. 它在TensorFlow–Keras实施,以利用高效的数据加载和通过tf.data API进行飞行上的增强. 与 tf.data 并行处理和预选. AUTOTUNE将I/O瓶颈降到最低,使用固定随机种子(42)进行散射,以确保可复制。

blocks.en: 3.3 Leakage-Aware Preprocessing and Evaluation Pipeline (PyTorch)
blocks.zh: 3.3 泄漏-预处理和评价管道(PyTorch)

blocks.en: Although the standard pipeline was sufficient for baseline evaluation, it did not address the data leakage risks that arise from aggregating multiple sources, including overlapping patients and inconsistent labeling. To enable robust cross-validation and cross-dataset analysis, an additional leakage-aware preprocessing pipeline was developed (Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh: 虽然标准管道足以进行基线评估,但它没有处理因汇总多种来源,包括病人重叠和标签不一致而产生的数据泄漏风险。 为了能够进行有力的交叉验证和跨数据集分析,开发了额外的渗漏感预处理管道(图2)。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Leakage-aware dataset preprocessing pipeline.
blocks.zh: 图2:漏损意识数据集预处理管道.

blocks.en: All four datasets were first consolidated into a single metadata table and mapped to a common label space of four classes, healthy (0), meningioma (1), glioma (2) and pituitary (3), to ensure consistent supervision across sources.
blocks.zh: 所有四个数据集首先合并成一个单一的元数据表,并绘制成健康(0)、脑膜瘤(1个)、胶片瘤(2个)和垂体炎(3个)的普通标签空间,以确保对各种来源进行一致的监督。

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Exact Duplicate Removal using MD5 Hashing
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 使用MD5Hashing精确重复清除

blocks.en: Overlap between the source datasets produces identical images. Exact duplicates were detected using MD5 hashing: images with identical hash values were treated as byte-wise duplicates, and only the first occurrence was retained so that redundant samples could not bias training or evaluation. In total, 550 exact duplicates were found and removed.

blocks.en: 3.3.3 Image Standardization and Enhancement
blocks.zh: 3.3.3 图像标准化和加强

blocks.en: Each retained image underwent a standardized preprocessing routine: • conversion to grayscale; • resizing to 224 × 224 224\times 224 pixels; • contrast enhancement using contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalization (CLAHE); • intensity normalization using an interquartile range (IQR)-based standardization scheme, which is less sensitive to outliers than min–max scaling; and • conversion to a three-channel format for compatibility with ImageNet-pretrained CNNs.

blocks.en: 3.3.4 Cluster-Aware Grouping for Leakage-Free Splits
blocks.zh: 3.3.4 无渗漏区块的分组

blocks.en: To further prevent leakage caused by visually related samples, images were clustered on their pHash values using a Hamming-distance threshold of 4, and each cluster was assigned an identifier so that highly similar images shared the same group. These clusters were used as grouping constraints during data splitting. A total of 48,065 clusters were formed, with a mean size of 1.014 images and a maximum size of 17.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步防止视觉相关样品造成的渗漏,利用4号汉明距离阈值将图像组合在pHash值上,每组都配有标识符,以便高度相似的图像共享同一组. 在数据分割过程中,这些分组被用作分组限制。 共形成48,065个集群,平均大小为1.014幅图像,最大大小为17幅.

blocks.en: All deduplication and split generation was performed offline ; the cleaned dataset was then consumed by PyTorch training scripts with no augmentation beyond standard normalization. Cross-validation and cross-dataset evaluation followed the protocols described in Sections 2.2.1 and 2.2.2 .

blocks.en: 3.4.1 End-to-End Trained Models
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 端到端训练型号

blocks.en: The baseline CNN, the attention CNN and ShuffleNet were initialized from scratch (Xavier/He initialization) and trained directly on the dataset. • Baseline CNN: This model served as the performance benchmark. It used a standard three-stage hierarchical feature extractor (32–64–128 channels) built from sequential blocks of 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution, ReLU activation and 2 × 2 2\times 2 max pooling (Table 1 ). • Attention CNN: An extension of the baseline model, it used a deeper four-stage convolutional hierarchy (up to 256 channels) with a spatial self-attention mechanism after the final convolutional layer. Feature maps from successive convolutional blocks are shown in Fig. 4 . Its main components are: – Hierarchical feature extraction: a four-stage CNN produces progressively deeper representations of the input; – Spatial attention: the network learns to weight the importance of different image regions when forming the final feature representation; – Context aggregation: the attention weights produce a context vector that emphasizes discriminative features; and – Classification: a two-layer dense network with dropout produces the final predictions. • ShuffleNet: ShuffleNet uses grouped convolutions and a channel shuffle operation and is optimized for computational efficiency. It reduces the number of floating-point operations (FLOPs) required for inference, making it well suited to resource-constrained environments while maintaining high performance. Its key optimizations are: – Grouped convolutions: reduce FLOPs by a factor of g g (typically g = 3 g=3 ); – Channel shuffling: enables information exchange between groups; – Cosine scheduling: learning-rate annealing with warm restarts; and – Weighted loss: addresses class imbalance through inverse-frequency weighting. This design achieves an approximately eightfold reduction in computation compared with standard convolutions.

blocks.en: 3.4.2 Transfer Learning and Attention-Enhanced Models
blocks.zh: 3.4.2 转移学习和增强关注模式

blocks.en: For EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50 and Xception, weights pre-trained on ImageNet were used to accelerate convergence and reuse features learned from a large corpus. • CBAM integration: All three transfer learning models integrate the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM), which refines the feature maps sequentially, applying attention first across channels ( what is important) and then across spatial dimensions ( where it is important) before classification. • Xception adapter: The Xception model additionally includes an adapter block, a lightweight bottleneck residual module that refines the pre-trained features and supports efficient domain adaptation with minimal parameter overhead. • Triple-enhanced Xception: The backbone produces features 𝐅 base \mathbf{F}_{\text{base}} , which the adapter refines into 𝐅 adapt \mathbf{F}_{\text{adapt}} and CBAM enhances into 𝐅 att \mathbf{F}_{\text{att}} . The classification head then applies batch normalization (BN), ReLU activation, dropout (rates 0.3 and 0.2) and dense layers (Fig. 5(a) ). • EfficientNet backbone: EfficientNet-B0 uses compound scaling (depth α ϕ \alpha^{\phi} , width β ϕ \beta^{\phi} , resolution γ ϕ \gamma^{\phi} ) with mobile inverted bottleneck convolution (MBConv) blocks (Fig. 5(b) ). • Training protocols: Two training protocols were used to adapt the models to deep features. Single-phase training was used for EfficientNet-B0 and Xception, and two-phase training for ResNet-50 only. – Single-phase: the backbone layers were frozen, and only the CBAM block, the adapter block (Xception only) and the classification head were trained. – Two-phase: the first phase trained the new head and CBAM; in the second phase, the final convolutional block (conv5) was unfrozen and fine-tuned with a learning rate reduced by a factor of 10.

blocks.en: 3.6.1 Optimization and Regularization Strategy

blocks.en: • Learning rate: Transfer learning models started with a conservative learning rate ( ∼ 10 − 4 \sim 10^{-4} ) to preserve the pre-trained weights, whereas models trained from scratch used a higher learning rate ( ∼ 10 − 3 \sim 10^{-3} ). ResNet-50 reduced its learning rate by a factor of 10 during the fine-tuning phase. • Adaptive scheduling: All experiments used the ReduceLROnPlateau scheduler, which monitors the validation loss and lowers the learning rate when the loss stops improving for a predefined number of epochs. • Early stopping: To limit overfitting, training was stopped when the validation loss failed to improve within the specified patience window. • Dropout: Dropout (rates from 0.2 to 0.5) was applied to the dense layers of the classification heads to improve generalization. • Model-specific optimizations: ShuffleNet used cosine learning-rate annealing and gradient clipping to maintain training stability.

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Model Training and Convergence
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 示范培训和协同

blocks.en: Training behavior varied substantially across architectures (Fig. 6 ). • Models trained from scratch: ShuffleNet showed the most stable convergence (Fig. 6 e), with loss decreasing smoothly from 5.0 to below 0.5 over 35 epochs and training and validation curves closely aligned. It reached approximately 97% accuracy and a recall of 95.1% with minimal overfitting. The attention CNN showed improved stability and achieved an overall test accuracy of 95.1%, with validation-loss fluctuations diminishing after epoch 20 (Fig. 6 d). The baseline CNN underperformed the other two, achieving an accuracy of 91.2% (Fig. 6 c). • Transfer learning models: EfficientNet-B0 (Fig. 6 a) converged smoothly with minimal overfitting; its training loss decreased from approximately 0.200 to about 0.025 over 20 epochs without significant oscillation. ResNet-50 showed more volatile training and required careful learning-rate scheduling across its two phases. Xception (Fig. 6 b) converged smoothly and consistently over 25 epochs: training accuracy rose steadily from 74% to 96%, while validation accuracy reached approximately 91% with little fluctuation.

blocks.en: 4.1.2 Computational Efficiency versus Performance
blocks.zh: 4.1.2 计算效率与业绩

blocks.en: The relationship between model complexity and performance has direct implications for clinical deployment. ShuffleNet achieved the best balance, reaching 97.1% accuracy with only 1.2M parameters, whereas ResNet-50 required 25.6M parameters to reach 84.2%. This 21-fold difference in parameter count shows that, under this split, an efficient architecture outperformed a much larger one.
blocks.zh: 模型复杂性和性能之间的关系对临床部署有直接影响. 摇摆 净值达到最佳平衡,只有1.2M参数的精度达到97.1%,而ResNet-50则需要25.6M参数达到84.2%。 参数计数的这一21倍差异表明,在这个拆分下,高效的架构表现优于更大的架构.

blocks.en: The grouped convolutions and channel shuffling in ShuffleNet reduce FLOPs by a factor of three. This efficiency makes deployment feasible in resource-constrained clinical environments, including point-of-care devices and telemedicine applications, where high-performance computing infrastructure may be unavailable.
blocks.zh: 在ShuffleNet中分组的演化和频道洗涤将FLOP减少3倍. 这种效率使得在资源紧张的临床环境中,包括在可能没有高性能计算基础设施的护理点装置和远程医疗应用中部署是可行的。

blocks.en: 4.1.3 Class-Specific Performance
blocks.zh: 4.1.3 特定类别业绩

blocks.en: Table 5 presents per-class performance, which shows consistent patterns across all models. Healthy scans (ShuffleNet recall: 99.4%) and pituitary tumors (ShuffleNet recall: 98.5%) were the easiest classes for every model, owing to their distinct anatomical and imaging characteristics.
blocks.zh: 表5列出每类业绩,显示所有模型的一致模式。 健康扫描(ShuffleNet recept:99.4%)和垂体瘤(ShuffleNet recept:98.5%)是每个模型最简单的分类,因为它们具有明显的解剖学和成像特征.

blocks.en:
In contrast, glioma and meningioma were the most challenging classes, with the greatest confusion occurring between the two. This is likely due to overlapping features, similar contrast-enhancement patterns and shared locations in the cerebral hemispheres.
The 4–7% improvement in glioma–meningioma discrimination provided by the attention mechanism suggests that spatial attention captures subtle morphological differences that the plain CNN misses. Class-wise accuracies for the custom models are shown in Fig. 7 .
blocks.zh:
相比之下,胶原瘤和脑膜炎是最具有挑战性的阶层,两者之间最大的混淆。 这可能是由于重叠的特征、相似的对比增强模式和大脑半球的共用地点。

blocks.en: 4.1.5 ROC and Precision–Recall Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.1.5 ROC和精密-召回分析

blocks.en:
ROC analysis (Fig. 9 ) showed strong discriminative capability across all models, with AUC values of at least 0.95. ShuffleNet achieved near-perfect discrimination, with per-class AUC values close to 1.0 (healthy: 1.000, meningioma: 0.997, glioma: 0.998, pituitary: 0.999), followed closely by the attention CNN, whose per-class AUC values ranged from 0.992 to 0.998.
AUC values above 0.99 indicate that an operating point exists at which both the false-positive rate and the false-negative rate are low. Low false-positive rates are important for clinical acceptance, and low false-negative rates minimize missed diagnoses, which is critical for patient safety.

blocks.en: 4.1.6 Interpretability of the Attention CNN
blocks.zh: 4.1.6 关注CNN的可解释性

blocks.en:
Grad-CAM visualization (Fig. 11 ) provides insight into the decision-making of the attention CNN. The activation maps concentrate on tumor-relevant regions and highlight areas of visible pathology; for glioma cases, activation concentrates on irregular tissue boundaries and contrast-enhancing regions.
This indicates that the network learned to focus on relevant regions without explicit localization supervision, which adds transparency to its diagnostic decisions.

blocks.en: 4.1.8 Transfer Learning Performance under the Standard Split
blocks.zh: 4.1.8 标准划分下的转移学习业绩

blocks.en: Under the standard split, the transfer learning models underperformed despite their architectural sophistication. Two factors may explain this: • Domain gap: ImageNet pre-training captures natural-image features (textures, objects, scenes) that may transfer poorly to medical imaging, whereas brain MRI characteristics (tissue contrast, anatomical structures and pathological patterns) call for specialized feature extraction. • Task-specific learning: custom architectures learn medically relevant features from initialization, and attention mechanisms can capture spatial relationships specific to tumor morphology. The poor performance of ResNet-50 (84.2%) despite its 25.6M parameters suggests that depth alone, without domain-specific design, gives limited benefit under this protocol. As shown in the following sections, however, this ranking does not hold once data leakage is controlled.
blocks.zh: 在标准划分下,转移学习模型尽管建筑精细,但表现不佳. • 领域差距: ImageNet的前期训练捕捉到自然图像特征(纹理,物体,场景),这些特征可能向医学成像转移不良,而脑磁共振特征(问题对比,解剖结构和病理规律)则需要专门的特征提取. • 任务特定学习:定制建筑从初始化中学习医学相关特征,注意力机制可以捕捉肿瘤形态特有的空间关系. 尽管ResNet-50(84.2%)的参数为25.6M,但其性能不佳,这表明,在没有特定域设计的情况下,仅深度就只能使该议定书受益有限。 然而,如下各节所示,一旦数据泄漏得到控制,这一排名就不会维持。

blocks.en: Domain gap: ImageNet pre-training captures natural-image features (textures, objects, scenes) that may transfer poorly to medical imaging, whereas brain MRI characteristics (tissue contrast, anatomical structures and pathological patterns) call for specialized feature extraction.
blocks.zh: 域间隙 : ImageNet的前期训练捕捉到自然图像特征(纹理,物体,场景),这些特征可能向医学成像转移不良,而脑磁共振特征(问题对比,解剖结构和病理规律)则需要专门的特征提取.

blocks.en: Task-specific learning: custom architectures learn medically relevant features from initialization, and attention mechanisms can capture spatial relationships specific to tumor morphology.
blocks.zh: 任务特异性学习:定制架构从初始化中学习医学相关特征,关注机制可以捕捉肿瘤形态特有的空间关系.

blocks.en: 4.2 Performance under Group K-Fold Cross-Validation
blocks.zh: 4.2 K-Fold交叉变异组的性能

blocks.en:
To evaluate in-distribution performance while strictly avoiding data leakage, all architectures were trained and evaluated with 5-fold group cross-validation on the deduplicated dataset, with pHash clusters kept within folds (Section 3.3 ). This ensured that duplicated or visually similar MRI scans were never split between training and validation sets.
Table 6 summarizes the mean, standard deviation and range of accuracy and the mean F1-score across the five folds.
blocks.zh:
为了在严格避免数据泄露的同时评价分布中的性能,对所有架构进行了培训和评价,在破损数据集上进行了5倍分组交叉验证,pHash集群保留在折叠内(第3.3节). 这确保了重复的或视觉上相似的核磁共振扫描从不在培训与验证组之间分开。
表6汇总了五折的平均值、标准差和准确度范围以及F1-分数。

blocks.zh: 表6:在5倍分组交叉验证(跨折叠的平均值和标准差)下所有模型的性能.

blocks.en: ShuffleNetV2 achieved the best overall performance, with a mean accuracy of 0.9841 ± 0.0016 0.9841\pm 0.0016 and an identical mean F1-score of 0.9841, showing both high discriminative power and stability across folds. Its very low standard deviation indicates robustness to data partitioning under leakage-free conditions.
blocks.zh: ShuffleNetV2取得了最佳的整体性能,平均精度为0.9841±0.016 0.9841\pm0.016,同样平均为0.9841的F1-分数,显示出高差别力和跨折叠的稳定性. 其极低的标准偏差表明,在无渗漏条件下,数据分割是可靠的。

blocks.en: EfficientNet-B0 followed closely with a mean accuracy of 0.9823 ± 0.0021 0.9823\pm 0.0021 , and Xception achieved 0.9741 ± 0.0031 0.9741\pm 0.0031 . Both performed strongly but with slightly higher variance than ShuffleNetV2, suggesting marginally lower stability across folds.
blocks.zh: 高效 净额B0 与0.9823±0.0021 0.9823\pm 0.0021 相近,Xception实现0.9741±0.0031 0.9741\pm 0.0031. 两者的性能都很强,但差异略高于ShuffleNetV2,这表明整个折叠的稳定性略低。

blocks.en: ResNet-50 achieved moderate performance ( 0.9521 ± 0.0033 0.9521\pm 0.0033 ), while the custom baseline and attention CNNs lagged considerably, with mean accuracies of 0.8950 and 0.8071, respectively. This ranking reverses the finding of Section 4.1 , where the transfer learning models appeared to underperform. The two protocols differ in implementation and preprocessing, so the comparison is not exact; however, one plausible explanation is that the standard split, which was not deduplicated, allowed near-identical images to appear in both training and test sets, favoring models that memorize the training distribution.
blocks.zh: ResNet-50取得了中等性能(0.9521±0.0033 0.9521\pm 0.0033),而自定义基线和注意力的CNN则大大滞后,平均速率分别为0.8950和0.8071. 这一排名推翻了第4.1节的结论,该节的转移学习模式似乎表现不佳. 两项协议在执行和预处理上有所不同,因此比较不准确;不过,一个合理的解释是,标准拆分没有破解,允许在训练集和试验集中出现近似相同的图像,偏好能够记住训练分布的模型.

blocks.en: Per-class F1-scores (Fig. 13 ) show that EfficientNet-B0 and ShuffleNetV2 achieved consistently high performance across all classes, exceeding 0.98 for the glioma and no-tumor classes and 0.96 for meningioma and pituitary tumors. blocks.en: 4.3 Cross-Dataset Generalization (LODO Evaluation)
blocks.zh: 4.3 跨数据集概况(LODO评价)

blocks.en: To evaluate cross-dataset generalization, the LODO protocol (Section 2.2.2 ) was applied: the Lakshan dataset was held out entirely for testing, and all remaining datasets were used for training. LODO provides a stringent estimate of real-world performance, in which test data come from a source never seen during training.
blocks.zh: 为了评价跨数据集的泛化,采用了LODO协议(第2.2.2节):拉克山数据集完全被保留用于测试,其余所有数据集都用于培训. LODO对现实世界的性能提供了严格的估计,其中测试数据来自训练中从未见过的来源.

In contrast, the lightweight and custom models degraded substantially, with the attention CNN dropping to 0.565 accuracy.

blocks.en: 4.4 Statistical Significance and Model Comparison
blocks.zh: 4.4 统计意义和模型比较

blocks.en: Paired t-tests on the per-fold K-fold accuracies were used to assess whether the observed differences were statistically significant (Table 8 ). Every tested comparison between EfficientNet-B0, ShuffleNetV2 or Xception and the custom CNNs was significant ( p < 10 − 4 p<10^{-4} ), as was the difference between ShuffleNetV2 and ResNet-50. The difference between EfficientNet-B0 and ShuffleNetV2 was not significant ( p = 0.19 p=0.19 ), indicating statistically equivalent in-distribution performance. Their LODO results, however, differ substantially, highlighting the stronger cross-dataset generalization of EfficientNet-B0.
blocks.zh: 利用每K倍速率的Paired t测试来评估观察到的差异在统计上是否具有重大意义(表8)。 每一次经过测试的“高效网络-B0”、“ShuffleNetV2”或“Xception”与自定义的CNN的比较都是重大的(p < 10 - 4 p < 10 QQ-4}),而“ShuffleNetV2”和“ResNet-50”之间的区别也是如此。 高效Net-B0与ShuffleNetV2的区别并不显著(p=0.19 p=0.19),表明统计上等效的分布性能. 然而,它们的LODO结果差别很大,突出表明了高效网络-B0的更强有力的跨数据集通用化。

blocks.en: Table 8 : Pairwise statistical significance testing (paired t-test on per-fold K-fold accuracy).
blocks.zh: 表8:对等统计意义测试(对每倍的K倍精度进行授标 t测试).

blocks.en: Table 9 compares all models under both the in-distribution (K-fold) and cross-dataset (LODO) settings. ShuffleNetV2 achieved the highest in-distribution performance (98.41% accuracy, F1-score 0.984), indicating the closest fit to the training distribution. EfficientNet-B0, however, showed the strongest cross-dataset generalization, with a LODO accuracy of 78.4%, outperforming all other models on the unseen dataset. This reveals a trade-off between peak in-distribution accuracy and robustness to domain shift.
blocks.zh: 表9比较了分配(K倍)和跨数据集(LODO)设置下的所有模型. 摇摆 NetV2实现了最高的分布性能(98.41%的精度,F1-分数0.984),表明最接近培训分布. 然而,高效的Net-B0显示了最强的跨数据集概括性,LODO精度为78.4%,在看不见的数据集上比所有其他模型都强。 这表明,在分配的峰值准确性与对域位转移的稳健性之间有权衡。

blocks.en: Table 9 : Overall model comparison under K-fold cross-validation and LODO evaluation.
blocks.zh: 表9:K倍交叉验证和LODO评价的总体模型比较。

blocks.en: 4.5 Per-Class Diagnostic Performance
blocks.zh: 4.5 每类诊断性能

blocks.en: Table 10 reports the class-wise F1-scores of the three best models. All three achieve near-perfect performance for the no-tumor and pituitary classes, reflecting their visually distinct anatomical and radiological patterns. Glioma classification is also strong, with F1-scores above 0.975 for all three models. Meningioma remains the most challenging class, with consistently lower F1-scores across architectures. This is clinically expected, as meningiomas can share imaging characteristics with gliomas and pituitary tumors.
blocks.zh: 表10列出三种最佳模式中的F1-分数。 这三个课程都为无肿瘤类和垂体类取得了近乎完美的性能,反映了它们视异的解剖学和放射学模式。 Glioma分类法也很强,所有三种模型的F1-分数都高于0.975. Meningioma仍然是最具挑战性的类别,F1分数在整个建筑中一直较低. 这在临床上是预期的,因为脑膜炎可以与胶原瘤和垂体瘤分享成像特征.

blocks.en: Table 10 : Per-class F1-scores of the best-performing models (K-fold evaluation).
blocks.zh: 表10:绩效最佳模式的F1-分数(K倍评价)。

blocks.en: 4.6 Error Analysis and Failure Modes
blocks.zh: 4.6 错误分析和失败模式

blocks.en: To understand the limitations of the best in-distribution model, a detailed error analysis of ShuffleNetV2 was performed using its pooled out-of-fold predictions, absolute and normalized confusion matrices, and misclassification statistics. The analysis reveals systematic patterns in its failures.
blocks.zh: 为了了解最佳分配模式的局限性,利用ShuffleNetV2的集合外预测、绝对和正常的混淆矩阵以及错误分类统计,对它进行了详细的错误分析。 分析显示其失败的系统性模式。

blocks.en: 4.6.1 Confusion Matrix Interpretation
blocks.zh: 4.6.1 混淆矩阵解释

blocks.en: Fig. 16 presents the absolute and normalized confusion matrices of ShuffleNetV2. The model achieved near-perfect discrimination for no tumor (99.68%) and pituitary tumors (99.21%), indicating that healthy brains and pituitary tumors have highly distinctive visual patterns that the network captures robustly.
blocks.zh: 图16列出了ShuffleNetV2的绝对和规范化的混淆矩阵。 该模型实现了对无肿瘤(99.68%)和垂体瘤(99.21%)的近乎完美的歧视,表明健康的大脑和垂体瘤具有高度独特的视觉模式,网络能很好地捕捉到这些模式.

blocks.en: Figure 16 : Error analysis of ShuffleNetV2: absolute confusion matrix (left) and row-normalized rates (right), pooled over the five folds.
blocks.zh: 图16:ShuffleNetV2的错误分析:绝对混淆矩阵(左)和行态化率(右),集合于五折.

blocks.en: Glioma is also classified with very high accuracy (97.96%), suggesting that tumors with strong contrast and irregular margins are reliably detected. Meningioma, however, has a comparatively lower recall (97.19%), with a non-negligible fraction of cases confused with glioma and pituitary tumors.
blocks.zh: Glioma也以非常高的精度(97.96%)被分类,表明具有强烈对比和不规则边距的肿瘤被可靠检测. 然而,脑膜炎的复发率相对较低(97.19%),有不可忽略的一小部分病例与胶原瘤和垂体瘤相混淆。

blocks.en: This asymmetry is clinically meaningful: meningiomas often present imaging features that partially overlap with gliomas (tumor mass and edema) and with pituitary tumors (location and shape), making them intrinsically harder to distinguish, even for radiologists.
blocks.zh: 这种不对称性在临床上是有意义的:meningiomas经常呈现成像特征,这些特征与胶原瘤(肿瘤质量和水肿)和垂体瘤(位置和形状)部分重叠,使其内在难以区分,甚至对于放射学家来说.

blocks.en: 4.6.2 Dominant Error Modes
blocks.zh: 4.6.2 主要错误模式

blocks.en:
Table 11 and Fig. 17 summarize the most frequent misclassification pairs.
They reveal strong bidirectional confusion between glioma and meningioma, which accounts for the largest share of errors. Although ShuffleNetV2 is highly accurate overall, it struggles when tumors have ambiguous boundaries, similar texture or otherwise overlapping characteristics.
blocks.zh:
表11和图17概括了最常见的误分类对.
它们揭示出胶原瘤和脑膜炎之间强烈的双向混淆,后者占误差的最大比例. 虽然ShuffleNetV2总体上高度准确,但当肿瘤有模糊的边界,相似的纹理或其他重叠特征时,它会挣扎.

blocks.en: Table 11 : Misclassification patterns of ShuffleNetV2 (error rate normalized by the number of true-class samples).
blocks.zh: 表11: ShuffleNetV2的错分类模式(误差率按真类样本数量正常化).

blocks.en: Figure 17 : Most frequent misclassification pairs of ShuffleNetV2.
blocks.zh: 图17:ShuffleNetV2最频繁的错分类对.

blocks.en: The meningioma–pituitary confusions are likely driven by tumor proximity and similar contrast-enhancement patterns, especially in low-resolution or motion-affected scans. Importantly, the no-tumor class had very low confusion rates with every tumor type ( < 0.2 % <0.2\% ), supporting the model’s reliability in ruling out disease.
blocks.zh: 脑膜瘤-医院的混乱可能是由于肿瘤的接近和类似的反照增强模式,特别是在低分辨率或受运动影响的扫描中。 重要的是,无肿瘤类与每类肿瘤的混淆率非常低( < 0.2% < 0.2% > ),支持模型在排除疾病方面的可靠性。

blocks.en: 4.7 Effect of Architectural Choices
blocks.zh: 4.7 建筑选择的效果

blocks.en: To assess the contribution of different architectural choices, the six models were compared as progressively more sophisticated designs: the baseline CNN, the attention CNN, ResNet-50, Xception, EfficientNet-B0 and ShuffleNetV2.
blocks.zh: 为了评估不同建筑选择的贡献,将这六个模型比作越来越精密的设计:基线CNN,关注CNN,ResNet-50,Xception,高效Net-B0和ShuffleNetV2.

blocks.en: The baseline CNN serves as the control model, with no pre-trained weights or attention. The attention CNN adds an attention module to test whether explicit spatial focus improves tumor discrimination. The remaining four models are established backbone architectures; EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50 and Xception are initialized from ImageNet weights, which allows the reuse of features learned on large natural-image datasets.
blocks.zh: 基线CNN作为控制模型,没有预先训练的重量或注意力. CNN的关注度增加了一个关注模块,用于测试明确的空间焦点是否改善了肿瘤歧视. 其余四个模型是既定的骨干架构; 高效Net-B0,ResNet-50和Xception是从ImageNet权重初始化的,这使得在大型自然图像数据集上学到的特性得以再利用.

blocks.en: Under leakage-aware evaluation, adding attention to a model trained from scratch did not help: the attention CNN scored lower than the baseline CNN in both K-fold (0.807 versus 0.895) and LODO (0.565 versus 0.653) evaluation. Attention alone was therefore insufficient, and possibly detrimental, when trained from scratch on this data. In contrast, all four backbone architectures outperformed both custom CNNs in K-fold evaluation (significantly so in every pair tested; Table 8 ), and the three ImageNet-pretrained models also generalized best under LODO.
blocks.zh: 在对渗漏的认识评价中,从零开始对受过训练的模型给予更多的注意没有帮助:在K倍(0.807比0.895)和LODO(0.565比0.653)的评价中,CNN的注意力比基线CNN低。 因此,如果从零开始就这一数据进行培训,仅仅注意这一点是不够的,也可能是有害的。 对比之下,所有四个主干架构在K倍评价中都优于自定义的CNN(在每对测试中明显如此;表8),在LODO下,3个ImageNet预设模型也得到了最普遍的普及.

blocks.en: Model size was not the deciding factor. ResNet-50, the largest backbone, trailed the lightweight ShuffleNetV2 in K-fold accuracy (0.952 versus 0.984), whereas ShuffleNetV2 trailed ResNet-50 under LODO (0.662 versus 0.717). EfficientNet-B0 offered the best overall balance: it was statistically tied with ShuffleNetV2 in-distribution and achieved the highest cross-dataset accuracy, suggesting that compound scaling combined with pre-trained representations gives the best trade-off between efficiency and robustness.
blocks.zh: 模型大小不是决定因素。 ResNet-50是最大的主干线,在K倍准确度(0.952比0.984)方面跟随轻量级ShuffleNetV2,而ShuffleNetV2则在LODO下跟随ResNet-50(0.662比0.717). 高效率的Net-B0提供了最佳的总体平衡:从统计学上讲,它与ShuffleNetV2的分布挂钩,并实现了最高的跨数据集精确度,这表明复合缩放与预先训练过的表述相结合,在效率和稳健性之间提供了最佳的权衡。

blocks.en: Overall, the choice of backbone and pre-training accounted for most of the performance differences, whereas adding attention to a from-scratch CNN provided no benefit in these experiments.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,骨干和预训的选择是大部分性能差异的原因之一,而增加关注从抽取的CNN却无济于事。

blocks.en: 4.8 Explainability via Grad-CAM
blocks.zh: 4.8 通过Grad-CAM进行解释

blocks.en:
To interpret the decision-making process and check its clinical plausibility, Grad-CAM was applied to the best in-distribution model, ShuffleNetV2. Grad-CAM produces heatmaps of the spatial regions that contribute most to a prediction, allowing verification that the model attends to anatomically meaningful tumor regions.
Representative examples from all four classes (no tumor, meningioma, glioma and pituitary tumor) are shown in Fig. 18 .
blocks.zh:
为了诠释决策过程并检查其临床可信度,Grad-CAM被应用到了最好的分配模式ShuffleNetV2. Grad-CAM产生空间区域的热图,对预测贡献最大,可以核实该模型涉及解剖有意义的肿瘤区域。
图18显示了所有四个类别(无肿瘤、脑膜瘤、胶质瘤和垂体瘤)的代表性例子。
(b) 国家

blocks.en: Figure 18 : Grad-CAM visualizations for ShuffleNetV2: (a) no tumor, (b) meningioma, (c) glioma, (d) pituitary tumor.
blocks.zh: 图18:ShuffleNetV2(a)无肿瘤、(b)脑膜瘤、(c)胶囊瘤、(d)垂体瘤。

blocks.en: For no-tumor cases, the Grad-CAM maps show diffuse, low-intensity activation without strong focal hotspots, indicating that the model recognizes the absence of pathological structures rather than relying on spurious artifacts.
blocks.zh: 对于无肿瘤病例,Grad-CAM地图显示没有强烈的焦点热点的散射性低强度激活,表明模型承认缺乏病理结构,而不是依赖虚假的文物.

blocks.en: For meningioma samples, activation concentrates strongly on the well-defined extra-axial tumor mass near the skull boundary, consistent with the radiological appearance of meningiomas. This suggests that the model learns shape- and boundary-driven features rather than global texture patterns.
blocks.zh: 对于脑膜瘤样本,激活会强烈集中在颅骨边界附近定义明确的外轴肿瘤质量上,与脑膜瘤的放射外观一致. 这表明模型学习的是形状和边界驱动的特征,而不是全球纹理模式.

blocks.en: For glioma, Grad-CAM highlights infiltrative intra-axial regions with irregular margins, closely matching the heterogeneous and invasive morphology of gliomas. Because glioma and meningioma can share intensity profiles despite their different spatial growth patterns, this is also consistent with the higher glioma–meningioma confusion observed in the error analysis.
blocks.zh: 对于胶原瘤,Grad-CAM突出显示轴内无规则边缘的渗透区,与胶原瘤的多样和侵入性形态紧密相匹配。 由于胶原瘤和meningioma尽管其空间生长模式不同,但仍可以分享强度剖面,这也与误差分析中观察到的较高的胶原瘤-meningioma混淆一致.

blocks.en: For pituitary tumors, the heatmaps are sharply localized around the sellar and suprasellar regions, corresponding to the anatomical location of pituitary adenomas. These compact, centered activations are consistent with the high classification accuracy for this class.
blocks.zh: 对于垂体瘤来说,热图在塞勒尔和超畅销区周围急剧局部化,相当于垂体腺瘤的解剖位置. 这些紧凑的,中心化的激活与这个类的高分类精度一致.

blocks.en: Overall, the Grad-CAM visualizations indicate that ShuffleNetV2 bases its predictions on clinically relevant tumor regions rather than on background or skull artifacts. This supports the view that its high K-fold performance reflects meaningful anatomical learning. Its weaker LODO performance, however, shows that attending to the right regions does not by itself guarantee robustness to a new data source.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,Grad-CAM可视化显示,ShuffleNetV2的预测基于临床相关的肿瘤区域,而不是背景或头骨文物. 这支持其高K倍性能反映有意义的解剖学学习的观点. 然而,其较弱的LODO性能表明,关注适当的地区本身并不能保证新数据来源的稳健性。

blocks.en: 4.9 Discussion
blocks.zh: 4.9 讨论情况

blocks.en: Under the standard split, the baseline CNN was generally confident ( > 0.9 >0.9 ) in its correct classifications but produced some low-confidence misclassifications, particularly between tumor subtypes, which motivated the stronger feature extractors evaluated subsequently. Grad-CAM maps of the attention CNN concentrated on regions corresponding to visible tumor masses, providing spatial interpretability, and its correct predictions received very high confidence scores (0.999). ShuffleNet was likewise highly confident in most correct predictions ( > 0.9 >0.9 ), while assigning lower confidence (0.252–0.292) to ambiguous cases, and its probability distributions showed clear class separation.
blocks.zh: 在标准划分下,基线CNN对其正确的分类一般有信心( > 0.9 > 0.9),但产生了一些低信心的错分类,特别是在肿瘤亚型之间,这促使了后来评价的更强的特征提取器. 关注的Grad-CAM地图CNN集中于与可见肿瘤质量相对应的区域,提供了空间可解释性,其正确的预测获得了极高的置信分数(0.999)。 摇摆 同样,Net对大多数正确的预测( > 0.9 > 0.9)具有高度信心,而对于模棱两可的情况则给予较低的信心(0.252–0.292),其概率分布显示有明显的分类。

blocks.en: The leakage-aware experiments, however, change the overall picture. Once exact and near-duplicate images were removed and similar images were kept within folds, the pretrained backbones and ShuffleNetV2 clearly outperformed the custom CNNs, and the attention module no longer improved on the baseline. When an entire data source was held out, every model lost between roughly 20 and 32 percentage points of accuracy, and the in-distribution ranking did not carry over: ShuffleNetV2, the best K-fold model, ranked fourth under LODO, while EfficientNet-B0 generalized best. Accuracy measured on random or K-fold splits of the training sources should therefore not be taken as an estimate of clinical performance.
blocks.zh: 然而,渗漏意识实验改变了总体情况。 一旦准确和近似复制的图像被移除,类似图像被保存在折叠内,预先训练的骨干和ShuffleNetV2明显超过了定制的CNN,关注模块在基线上不再改进. 当一个完整的数据源被保持出来时,每个模型都损失了大约20到32个百分点的精确度,内部分配排名没有延续: ShuffleNetV2,最佳K倍数模型,在LODO下排名第四,而高效Net-B0则被概括为最佳. 因此,不应将按培训来源的随机或K倍分数测量的准确性作为临床表现的估计。

blocks.en: Several limitations should be considered when translating these results to clinical practice: • Data provenance: all four datasets are publicly available collections without patient identifiers or scanner metadata, so patient-level separation could only be approximated through image hashing, and the datasets may not capture the full range of imaging protocols, scanners and populations encountered clinically. • Limited cross-dataset testing: only one dataset could serve as a held-out test source, because it is the only one containing all four classes; generalization to other sources remains to be confirmed. • Class balance: despite mitigation strategies, residual class imbalance may introduce biases that affect real-world performance where tumor prevalence differs from the training data. • Single-modality, 2D input: clinical diagnosis typically incorporates patient history, symptoms, additional MRI sequences and volumetric information, none of which were included in this slice-based evaluation.
blocks.zh: 在将这些结果转化为临床实践时,应当考虑几个局限性: • 数据出处:所有四个数据集都是可公开获取的,没有患者识别器或扫描元数据,因此患者层面的分离只能通过图像散列来进行近似,数据集可能无法捕捉到临床上遇到的全部成像协议,扫描仪和人群. • 有限的跨数据集测试:只有一个数据集可以用作搁置测试源,因为它是唯一包含所有四个类别的数据;对其他来源的概括尚待确认。 • 支助 班级平衡:尽管有缓解战略,但剩余班级不平衡可能带来偏见,影响肿瘤流行率与培训数据不同的现实世界业绩。 • 单一模式,2D输入:临床诊断通常包括病人的病史、症状、额外的核磁共振序列和体积信息,这些都未列入这一切片评价。

blocks.en: Data provenance: all four datasets are publicly available collections without patient identifiers or scanner metadata, so patient-level separation could only be approximated through image hashing, and the datasets may not capture the full range of imaging protocols, scanners and populations encountered clinically.
blocks.zh: 数据来源:所有四个数据集都是没有患者识别器或扫描元数据可公开获取的集合,因此患者层面的分离只能通过图像散列来进行近似,数据集可能无法捕捉到临床上遇到的全部成像协议,扫描仪和人群.

blocks.en: Limited cross-dataset testing: only one dataset could serve as a held-out test source, because it is the only one containing all four classes; generalization to other sources remains to be confirmed.
blocks.zh: 有限的跨数据集测试:只有一个数据集可以作为搁置测试源,因为它是唯一包含所有四类数据;对其他来源的归纳仍有待确认.

blocks.en: Class balance: despite mitigation strategies, residual class imbalance may introduce biases that affect real-world performance where tumor prevalence differs from the training data.
blocks.zh: 班级平衡:尽管有缓解战略,但剩余班级不平衡可能带来偏见,影响肿瘤流行率与培训数据不同的现实世界业绩。

blocks.en: Single-modality, 2D input: clinical diagnosis typically incorporates patient history, symptoms, additional MRI sequences and volumetric information, none of which were included in this slice-based evaluation.
blocks.zh: 单模式,2D输入:临床诊断通常包括病人的病史,症状,额外的核磁共振序列和体积信息,这些都不包括在这种切片评价中.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: This study compared six deep learning architectures for four-class brain tumor classification on a corpus assembled from four public MRI datasets, under three evaluation protocols. Under a conventional random split, the efficient ShuffleNet achieved the highest accuracy (97.1%) with only 1.2M parameters, and the models trained from scratch appeared to outperform transfer learning. Under leakage-aware group K-fold cross-validation, this ranking reversed: ShuffleNetV2 (98.41%) and EfficientNet-B0 (98.23%) were statistically indistinguishable and both significantly outperformed the custom CNNs, and the attention module did not improve on the baseline CNN. When an entire dataset was held out, all models degraded substantially; EfficientNet-B0 generalized best (78.4%), whereas ShuffleNetV2 fell to 66.2%.
blocks.zh: 这项研究比较了根据三个评价协议从四个公共核磁共振数据集组装的四级脑瘤分类的六个深层学习架构。 在常规的随机分割下,高效的ShuffleNet实现了最高的精度(97.1%),只有1.2M参数,从零开始训练的模型似乎超过了转录学习. 在渗漏感知组K倍交叉验证下,这一排名逆转:ShuffleNetV2(98.41%)和高效Net-B0(98.23%)在统计学上是无法区分的,并且两者都明显优于定制的CNN,关注模块在基线CNN上没有改进. 当一个完整的数据集被保存出来时,所有模型都严重退化; 高效的Net-B0通用最佳(78.4%),而ShuffleNetV2则下降到66.2%。

blocks.en: These findings show that the choice of evaluation protocol can change both the absolute performance and the ranking of models, and that deduplication, grouped splitting and cross-dataset testing are necessary for realistic performance estimates. Among the models evaluated, EfficientNet-B0 offers the best combination of in-distribution accuracy, cross-dataset robustness and computational efficiency, while ShuffleNetV2 remains attractive where computational resources are very limited and the deployment data closely match the training data. The persistent glioma–meningioma confusion across all architectures reflects the inherent difficulty of this distinction and positions AI as a complementary tool rather than a replacement for clinical expertise.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果表明,选择评价协议既可以改变模型的绝对性能,又可以改变模型的排名,而分层、分组和跨数据集的测试对于实际性能估计是必要的。 在所评价的模型中,效率网-B0提供了分配精确度、跨数据集稳健性和计算效率的最佳组合,而ShuffleNetV2仍然具有吸引力,因为计算资源有限,部署数据与培训数据密切匹配。 在所有结构中,一直存在的胶片瘤-meningioma混淆反映了这种区别的固有困难,并且认为AI是一种补充工具,而不是临床专门知识的替代。

blocks.en: Building on the current 2D framework, future work will develop 3D volumetric analysis for glioma subtype classification coupled with cognitive impact assessment, addressing several clinical needs: • 3D volumetric architecture: extending efficient architectures to 3D convolutions will capture volumetric tumor characteristics, growth patterns and spatial relationships with eloquent brain regions. A 3D approach enables analysis of tumor heterogeneity, necrotic regions and enhancement patterns that are crucial for glioma grading (WHO grades 1–4) and molecular subtyping (IDH-mutant versus IDH-wildtype, 1p/19q codeletion status). • Cognitive function correlation: integrating neuropsychological assessment data with 3D imaging will enable prediction of cognitive deficits from tumor location, size and proximity to functional areas. Such a multimodal approach could identify patients at risk of language, memory or executive-function impairment, guiding treatment decisions and rehabilitation planning. • Generalization and clinical implementation: the 3D system will retain the computational efficiency principles established here and will be validated on multiple independent, held-out data sources to ensure deployment feasibility in clinical settings.
blocks.zh: 在目前的2D框架的基础上,今后的工作将开发胶原亚型分类的3D体积分析,同时进行认知影响评估,满足几个临床需求: 3D体积结构:将高效的架构扩展到3D的演化,将捕捉体积肿瘤特征,生长模式和与雄辩的大脑区域的空间关系. 3D方法能够分析肿瘤的异质性、坏死区和增强模式,而这些模式对胶原分级(世卫组织1-4年级)和分子亚型(IDH-mutant对IDH-wildtype,1p/19q编码状态)至关重要。 • 认知功能关联:将神经心理学评估数据与3D成像相结合,将能够预测肿瘤位置、大小和接近功能区的认知缺陷。 这种多式办法可以确定面临语言、记忆或执行功能障碍风险的病人,指导治疗决定和恢复规划。 • 一般化和临床实施:3D系统将保留在此确立的计算效率原则,并将在多个独立、搁置的数据来源上验证,以确保在临床环境中部署的可行性。
